People reveals 2025 Sexiest Man Alive The magazine has been crowning Hollywood's best-looking man since 1985, when Mel Gibson first won the title. ... WASHINGTON —"Wicked" star Jonathan Bailey has been officially crowned as People's Sexiest Man Alive for 2025. The selection was announced Monday by People Magazine, which annually selects a group of celebrities as finalists for the award. The honor is partly based on good looks and philanthropic efforts. Bailey is the first openly gay man to be selected for the honor. The 37-year-old British heartthrob, who plays Fiyero in the "Wicked" films, appeared on "The Tonight Show Starring ... The magazine has been crowning Hollywood's best-looking man since 1985, when Mel Gibson first won the title. Past honorees include Patrick Dempsey, John Legend, Dwayne Johnson, Idris Elba, Adam Levine, Richard Gere, Channing Tatum and David Beckham. Bailey inherited the title from John Krasinski, who was named 2024's Sexiest Man Alive. Only three men have held the title twice: Brad Pitt, George Clooney and Johnny Depp. In 1993, Richard Gere also made the list for a second time, but was honored alongside his then wife Cindy Crawford for a Sexiest Couple Alive edition.
